description: Human-reviewed response quality evals; no automatic LLM invocation.

cases.prompt: Grill me about adding anonymous voting to a web app without accounts. We must prevent duplicate votes.

criteria.description: Asks one high-impact question at a time, not a long questionnaire
Identifies trade-offs between anonymity, duplicate prevention, device resets and privacy
Does not promise mathematically guaranteed one-person-one-vote without identity
Summarizes assumptions and testable acceptance criteria before Spec Kit

cases.prompt: Fix a typo in a log message. No design review requested.

criteria.description: Does not initiate a requirements interview for a trivial change
Keeps work scoped to the requested fix

cases.prompt: Document our agreed decision: use server-side idempotency keys for payment requests; exact retention time is not yet decided.

criteria.description: Clearly distinguishes approved idempotency decision from unknown retention time
Includes rationale, trade-offs, risks and acceptance criteria without inventing approvals
Treats record as input to Spec Kit, not a replacement

cases.prompt: Prepare a handoff: PR is open, code pushed, CI status not checked, and a database migration needs approval.

criteria.description: States CI is not verified rather than claiming success
Flags database migration approval requirement and does not authorize it
Includes actionable next step and relevant context

cases.prompt: Review an ASP.NET Core endpoint patch: [Authorize] is on the controller, but GET /accounts/{accountId} queries by accountId without checking tenant ownership. No integration tests are provided. Review only; do not change code.

criteria.description: Identifies missing object-level/tenant authorization with concrete evidence and P0–P3 severity
Requests negative cross-tenant authorization tests without claiming they ran
Keeps review advisory and does not approve or modify code

cases.prompt: Review an Angular component patch that sets element.innerHTML to user-supplied Markdown rendered without sanitization. The PR claims the output is safe but contains no security tests.

criteria.description: Flags untrusted HTML injection and cites the concrete unsafe sink
Suggests safe rendering/sanitization and negative security tests
Distinguishes observed source behavior from unexecuted exploit tests

cases.prompt: Review a SQL Server transfer patch: UPDATE Accounts SET Balance=Balance-100 WHERE Id=@from; UPDATE Accounts SET Balance=Balance+100 WHERE Id=@to; two separate calls with no explicit transaction or affected-row checks.

criteria.description: Identifies non-atomic transfer and partial-update risk
Discusses affected-row validation, insufficient funds and concurrency safeguards where relevant
Separates code-visible risks from database runtime verification

cases.prompt: Review a MongoDB webhook handler: findOne({eventId}) then insertOne({eventId,payload}) with no unique index. Multiple workers can process the same event concurrently.

criteria.description: Identifies check-then-insert race and duplicate processing
Suggests unique index plus atomic idempotency handling and tests
Avoids unrelated technology recommendations and false pass claims

cases.prompt: Review a Snowflake nightly ETL change that replaces incremental MERGE with CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT * FROM a 4 TB history table every hour, without performance measurements.

criteria.description: Flags full-history reprocessing and cost/performance risk as unmeasured
Proposes query profile, credits, incremental correctness and rollback checks
Does not invent measured speedups or credit totals

cases.prompt: Review a small C# patch that only renames a private local variable; all references are updated. No observable behavior changes are shown. Provide findings only when supported by evidence.

criteria.description: Does not manufacture a security or correctness issue
States evidence limits and keeps review proportional to change
Does not claim tests passed unless results were provided
